create_llvm_env_local: create a local LLVM CompilerGym environment using gym.make('llvm-v0')
create_llvm_env_service: create an LLVM environment connected to a remote CompilerGym service binary
reset_llvm_benchmark: reset the LLVM environment with a specific benchmark like cbench-v1/crc32
step_llvm_compiler_pass: step the LLVM environment with a compiler pass action such as -mem2reg
multistep_llvm_actions: apply multiple compiler pass actions at once using env.multistep with a list of actions
